sloka: मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् ।अमर्षमतुलं लेभे प्रतिज्ञां चाकरोत्तदा ।। ७.९.४४ ॥
transliteration: mātustadvacanaṁ śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।amarṣamatulaṁ lebhe pratijñāṁ cākarottadā ।। 7.9.44 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that speech of his mother, the valorous Dashagriva felt unequalled indignation and then made a vow.
